review_candidates.title: Senior Backend Developer (Python / Go)
review_candidates.description: Acronis is a global leader in cyber protection, delivering AI-powered protection for productive MSPs in a single, natively integrated platform that unifies operations management, cybersecurity, and data protection. Driven by our mission to protect, manage and automate every workload that businesses and lives depend on, we've built the industry's only all-in-one solution. We are looking for a Senior Backend Developer who will be responsible for the design and development of the management backend of our hyperconverged infrastructure and IaaS platform — the services and APIs behind the admin and self-service panels that let service providers and their customers run compute, storage and networking as a service — with a focus on multitenancy, cluster lifecycle automation, and reliability under production load. What You'll Do Design, develop and maintain backend services and public APIs (Python and Go) for new and existing features of the platform's management layer, translating software requirements into stable, high-quality, high-performance code. Build the services that orchestrate the platform itself: cluster and node lifecycle (deployment, adding and releasing nodes, maintenance mode, high availability), rolling updates of the whole stack, configuration management, and recovery from partial failures. Develop the multi-tenant and multi-tier model behind the product: projects and tenants, quotas and limits, role-based access control, authentication and authorization, audit, and the self-service surface exposed to a service provider's own customers. Develop monitoring, alerting, metrics and reporting pipelines, and the telemetry the platform and our support teams rely on to see what a cluster is doing. Design data models and work with the databases and message queues behind the services, keeping schema and API changes backward compatible across supported upgrade paths. Investigate and resolve complex issues in development and production clusters — API and service failures, concurrency and race conditions, stuck orchestration tasks, performance and scalability bottlenecks — and drive them from root-cause analysis through implementation, validation and production. Contribute to the architecture and interface design of management components and their integration with higher-level Acronis products and partner-facing APIs. Own the quality of what you build: unit, functional and integration tests, API contract tests, fault-injection and scale testing, code reviews, and CI coverage for your services. Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools for development, code analysis, debugging, root-cause investigation, trace/log analysis and technical research. Write software and operational documentation, and work closely with QA, support and the product team to deliver high-quality software to service providers and their customers. Share expertise in backend and distributed systems design through technical discussions, design and code reviews, and documentation, and mentor engineers joining the team. Maintain clear communication with the Management Backend Team lead on progress, technical challenges, risks, dependencies and critical issues. Who We're Looking For 5+ years of relevant backend software development experience, with a track record of shipping and supporting production services. Strong Python; solid Go, or the ability and willingness to work across both languages day to day. Proven experience designing and building microservices and REST APIs that run under high load, including their versioning, compatibility and documentation. Solid understanding of distributed systems: asynchronous task processing and orchestration, idempotency and retries, consistency and failure handling, and how a service behaves when its dependencies are slow or gone. Hands-on experience with relational databases (schema design, migrations, query performance) and with message queues or brokers; experience with key-value or distributed configuration stores is a plus. Good working knowledge of Linux, containers, and the deployment and packaging of services (systemd, RPM packaging, Docker or comparable), plus solid command-line and scripting skills. Practical experience with authentication, authorization and multi-tenant access control models. Experience with cloud infrastructure or virtualization platforms — OpenStack, Kubernetes, software-defined storage or networking — is a strong advantage. Experience with monitoring and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK or comparable) is an advantage. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to debug problems that span services, databases, the operating system and the infrastructure layers underneath. AI-assisted engineering experience is mandatory, including practical use of AI for development, debugging, code analysis, investigation and technical research. Demonstrated ability to take technical ownership of a service, work with a large inherited codebase, and share technical expertise across teams. Excellent English communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Please submit your resume and application in English Who We Are A Swiss company founded in Singapore in 2003, Acronis offers over twenty years of innovation with 15 offices worldwide and employees in 50+ countries. Acronis Cyber Protect is available in 26 languages in 150 countries and is used by over 21,000 service providers to protect more than 750,000 businesses. Our corporate culture centers on innovation, accountability, and impact. We encourage our people to think boldly, challenge conventional approaches, and take ownership of outcomes. As a member of our global “A-Team,” you’ll operate in a high-growth, fast-paced environment where resilience, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement drive success. OUR INTERVIEW PRACTICES To ensure a fair and genuine hiring process, candidates are expected to participate in interviews without the use of AI tools, automated prompts, or third-party assistance. Interviews are designed to assess individual skills, experience, and communication style, and we value authentic, real-time interaction. Use of AI or external assistance during live interviews may result in disqualification. For roles where AI skills are being evaluated, permitted use of AI tools will be clearly communicated in advance. Candidates may be asked to disable virtual backgrounds or participate in in-person interviews. All employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of applicable criminal, education and identity background checks Acronis is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, medical condition, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

review_candidates.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Flexcompute is leading the transformation of engineering simulation with our revolutionary ultra-fast simulation technology. Our flagship products, including the industry-leading Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) software Flow360 and electromagnetic simulation software Tidy3D, are reshaping how simulations are conducted across diverse sectors. Founded by visionaries from Stanford and MIT and supported by top-tier venture capital firms, we are a rapidly growing team dedicated to breaking boundaries and challenging the norms of the multi-billion-dollar engineering simulation market. Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer to help us design and implement scalable solutions that meet the growing demands of our advanced EM simulation platform. Additionally, the candidate will help us enhance our data management, frontend-backend API unification, and cloud integration. Key Responsibilities Contribute to general software development efforts, such as API unification, simulation data management (e.g., caching, syncing, storage), and scripting improvements Collaborate with EM and infrastructure teams to implement simulation-specific solutions, including enhancements to back-end/scheduler integrations and Python front-end functionality Improve our task pipelines through an innovative design for a web API in a multi-physical simulation context Develop and maintain hybrid cloud compute and storage solutions, integrating on-premise HPC systems with modern cloud platforms Optimize and manage high-performance computing clusters equipped with high-speed interconnects This is a senior seat. We keep the team small and senior on purpose, so you will own real pieces of the platform end to end, with little direction and direct access to the founders. Requirements What you need Strong backend engineering in at least one of Java, Python or C++. Deep in one is enough Real production cloud experience, AWS preferred Distributed systems you have operated in production, not only studied Direct ownership of a production backend service, from design through deployment and operation Fluent professional English, spoken and written Based in Greece, or willing to relocate to Greece, with the right to work there without visa sponsorship, and available for four to six hours of overlap with our Boston team (afternoon and early evening in Athens) A bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, telecommunications engineering or a closely related field What You Can Learn Here We hire for depth, not checklists.
